--[[

    Only item bringing + player features. No chat, no spam, no remotes.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local lp = Players.LocalPlayer

-- =========================================================
-- CONFIG
-- =========================================================
local function toSet(list)

end

local CATEGORY_ORDER = { "diamonds", "valuables", "fuel", "food", "healing", "weapons", "armor", "tools", "materials", "magic", "chests" }

local EXCLUDED = toSet({
    "part", "model", "meshpart", "union", "unionoperation", "wedge", "wedgepart", "cornerwedgepart",
    "trusspart", "seat", "vehicleseat", "decal", "texture", "folder", "effect", "hitbox", "trigger",
    "zone", "region", "collider", "invisible",
    "terrain", "baseplate", "spawn", "spawnlocation", "camera", "sky", "handle",
    "rootjoint", "torso", "head", "limb", "humanoidrootpart",
})

local CAP_OPTIONS = { 25, 50, 150, 300, 600, 1500 }
local MAX_ITEM_SIZE = 60 -- anything bigger is treated as map geometry
local SKIP_NEAR = 12     -- items already this close to you are skipped

local S = {
    capIndex = 2,
    includeAnchored = false,
    autoCategory = "all",
    autoDelay = 3,
    perf = false,
    campOffset = 3,
}

-- =========================================================
-- NAME MATCHING (whole words only)
-- =========================================================
local tokenCache, tokenCacheCount = {}, 0
local function tokenize(name)
    local cached = tokenCache[name]
    if cached then return cached end
    -- "StrongAxe" -> "strong axe", "raw_meat" -> "raw meat"
    local s = name:gsub("(%l)(%u)", "%1 %2"):gsub("[^%w]+", " "):lower()
    local tokens = {}
    for w in s:gmatch("%S+") do tokens[#tokens + 1] = w end
    if tokenCacheCount > 20000 then tokenCache, tokenCacheCount = {}, 0 end
    tokenCache[name] = tokens
    tokenCacheCount += 1
    return tokens
end

local function matchesSet(name, set)
    for _, t in ipairs(tokenize(name)) do
        if set[t] then return true end
        if t:sub(-1) == "s" and set[t:sub(1, -2)] then return true end -- plurals
    end
    return false
end

local function matchesCategory(name, cat)
    if cat == "all" then
        for _, c in ipairs(CATEGORY_ORDER) do
            if matchesSet(name, CATEGORIES[c]) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    return matchesSet(name, CATEGORIES[cat])
end

-- =========================================================
-- ITEM LOGIC
-- =========================================================
local moved = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local npcCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    moved = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
end)

local function getHRP()
    local c = lp.Character
    return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

-- true if this belongs to a player or an NPC/animal (anything with a Humanoid)
local function isLiving(inst)
    local cached = npcCache[inst]
    if cached ~= nil then return cached end
    local result = false
    -- player characters (yours and others')
    if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(inst) or inst:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model") and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(inst:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")) then
        result = true
    end
    local char = lp.Character
    if char and (inst == char or inst:IsDescendantOf(char)) then result = true end
    -- NPCs, animals, pets, followers: anything rigged or animated
    local m = inst:IsA("Model") and inst or inst:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    local depth = 0
    while not result and m and m ~= workspace and depth < 6 do
        if m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            or m:FindFirstChildOfClass("AnimationController")
            or m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Motor6D", true)
            or m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animator", true) then
            result = true
            break
        end
        m = m:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        depth += 1
    end
    -- things attached to or chasing a character (pets, companions)
    if not result then
        local parts = inst:IsA("BasePart") and { inst } or inst:GetDescendants()
        for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                for _, j in ipairs(p:GetJoints()) do
                    local other = (j.Part0 == p) and j.Part1 or j.Part0
                    if other and other:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                        and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(other:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")) then
                        result = true
                        break
                    end
                end
                if p:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("AlignPosition") or p:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BodyPosition")
                    or p:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BodyGyro") or p:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("AlignOrientation") then
                    result = true
                end
            end
            if result then break end
        end
    end
    npcCache[inst] = result
    return result
end

local function isMovable(d)
    if d:IsA("BasePart") then
        return (S.includeAnchored or not d.Anchored) and d.Size.Magnitude <= MAX_ITEM_SIZE
    end
    if d:GetExtentsSize().Magnitude > MAX_ITEM_SIZE then return false end
    if S.includeAnchored then return true end
    for _, p in ipairs(d:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") and not p.Anchored then return true end
    end
    return false
end

-- if a parent Model already matches, we move that Model instead of its parts
local function ancestorModelMatches(d, matcher)
    local m = d.Parent
    while m and m ~= workspace do
        if m:IsA("Model") and matcher(m.Name) then return true end
        m = m.Parent
    end
    return false
end

local function itemPosition(d)
    return d:IsA("Model") and d:GetPivot().Position or d.Position
end

-- extra text a game may use to label an item (ProximityPrompt text, Attributes)
local labelCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local function labelText(d)
    local cached = labelCache[d]
    if cached then return cached end
    local parts = {}
    for _, c in ipairs(d:GetChildren()) do
        if c:IsA("ProximityPrompt") or c:IsA("ClickDetector") then
            if c:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
                parts[#parts + 1] = c.ObjectText
                parts[#parts + 1] = c.ActionText
            end
        elseif c:IsA("StringValue") then
            parts[#parts + 1] = c.Value
        end
    end
    for _, key in ipairs({ "ItemName", "Item", "Name", "DisplayName", "Type" }) do
        local v = d:GetAttribute(key)
        if type(v) == "string" then parts[#parts + 1] = v end
    end
    local text = table.concat(parts, " ")
    labelCache[d] = text
    return text
end

local function isVisible(d)
    if d:IsA("BasePart") then return d.Transparency < 0.9 end
    for _, p in ipairs(d:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Transparency < 0.9 then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function isCandidate(d, matcher, hrpPos)
    if moved[d] then return false end
    if EXCLUDED[d.Name:lower()] then return false end
    if not (matcher(d.Name) or matcher(labelText(d))) then return false end
    if isLiving(d) then return false end
    if ancestorModelMatches(d, matcher) then return false end
    if not isMovable(d) then return false end
    if not isVisible(d) then return false end
    if (itemPosition(d) - hrpPos).Magnitude < SKIP_NEAR then return false end
    return true
end

local function moveItem(item, cf)
    return pcall(function()
        if item:IsA("Model") then
            item:PivotTo(cf)
            for _, p in ipairs(item:GetDescendants()) do
                if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                    p.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    p.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end
            end
        else
            item.CFrame = cf
            item.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            item.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end
    end)
end

-- Let the executor give us physics ownership of nearby parts (if supported)
pcall(function()
    if sethiddenproperty then
        sethiddenproperty(lp, "SimulationRadius", math.huge)
        sethiddenproperty(lp, "MaxSimulationRadius", math.huge)
    end
end)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------
-- INDEX: scan the workspace once, then keep it updated with events,
-- so we never re-walk every descendant on each bring / auto tick.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------
local idxList, idxSet = {}, setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local idxReady, idxBuilding = false, false

local function indexAdd(d)
    if (d:IsA("Model") or d:IsA("BasePart")) and not idxSet[d] then
        idxSet[d] = true
        idxList[#idxList + 1] = d
    end
end

workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(indexAdd)

local function ensureIndex()
    if idxReady then return end
    if idxBuilding then
        while not idxReady do task.wait(0.1) end
        return
    end
    idxBuilding = true
    local n = 0
    for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        indexAdd(d)
        n += 1
        if n % 2000 == 0 then task.wait() end
    end
    idxReady, idxBuilding = true, false
end

-- iterate the index in small slices, dropping destroyed instances
local function forEachIndexed(fn)
    ensureIndex()
    local write = 0
    local read = 0
    local total = #idxList
    while read < total do
        read += 1
        local d = idxList[read]
        if d.Parent then
            write += 1
            idxList[write] = d
            if fn(d) == false then
                -- stop early: keep the rest of the list intact
                for i = read + 1, total do
                    write += 1
                    idxList[write] = idxList[i]
                end
                read = total
            end
        end
        if read % 250 == 0 then task.wait() end
    end
    -- anything added while we yielded sits after `total`
    for i = total + 1, #idxList do
        write += 1
        idxList[write] = idxList[i]
    end
    for i = #idxList, write + 1, -1 do idxList[i] = nil end
end

local toCampfire = false
local function findCampfire()
    for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        local n = d.Name:lower()
        if n:find("campfire", 1, true) or n:find("bonfire", 1, true) or n:find("firepit", 1, true) or n:find("fire_pit", 1, true) then
            if d:IsA("BasePart") then return d end
            if d:IsA("Model") then
                local p = d.PrimaryPart or d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                if p then return p end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- where items land: next to you, or on top of the campfire
local function getTargetCF(hrp)
    if toCampfire then
        local cf = findCampfire()
        if cf then return cf.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, S.campOffset, 0), true end
    end
    return hrp.CFrame, false
end

local busy = false
local function bring(matcher, cap)
    local hrp = getHRP()
    if not hrp then return 0 end
    local brought = 0

    forEachIndexed(function(d)
        if brought >= cap then return false end
        local ok, good = pcall(isCandidate, d, matcher, hrp.Position)
        if ok and good then
            local base = getTargetCF(hrp)
            local offset = CFrame.new(math.random(-6, 6), 2, math.random(-6, 6))
            if moveItem(d, base * offset) then
                moved[d] = true
                brought += 1
            end
        end
    end)
    return brought
end

-- Brings every chest and lines them up in a grid in front of you
local function bringChestsInFront()
    local hrp = getHRP()
    if not hrp then return 0 end
    local matcher = function(name) return matchesCategory(name, "chests") end
    local hrpPos = hrp.Position

    local found = {}
    forEachIndexed(function(d)
        local ok, good = pcall(isCandidate, d, matcher, hrpPos)
        if ok and good then found[#found + 1] = d end
    end)

    local COLUMNS, SPACING, DISTANCE = 6, 6, 12
    local origin = hrp.CFrame
    local brought = 0
    for i, chest in ipairs(found) do
        local col = (i - 1) % COLUMNS
        local row = math.floor((i - 1) / COLUMNS)
        local x = (col - (COLUMNS - 1) / 2) * SPACING
        local z = -(DISTANCE + row * SPACING)
        -- ground-level spot in front of you, chest turned to face you
        local pos = (origin * CFrame.new(x, -2, z)).Position
        local cf = CFrame.lookAt(pos, Vector3.new(origin.Position.X, pos.Y, origin.Position.Z))
        if moveItem(chest, cf) then
            moved[chest] = true
            brought += 1
        end
        if i % 20 == 0 then task.wait() end
    end
    return brought
end


local function currentCap()
    local c = CAP_OPTIONS[S.capIndex]
    return S.perf and math.min(c, 50) or c
end

-- bring the N closest items of any category
local function bringNearest(count)
    local hrp = getHRP()
    if not hrp then return 0 end
    local matcher = function(name) return matchesCategory(name, "all") end
    local found = {}
    forEachIndexed(function(d)
        local ok, good = pcall(isCandidate, d, matcher, hrp.Position)
        if ok and good then
            found[#found + 1] = { inst = d, dist = (itemPosition(d) - hrp.Position).Magnitude }
        end
    end)
    table.sort(found, function(a, b) return a.dist < b.dist end)
    local brought = 0
    for i = 1, math.min(count, #found) do
        local base = getTargetCF(hrp)
        local offset = CFrame.new(math.random(-6, 6), 2, math.random(-6, 6))
        if moveItem(found[i].inst, base * offset) then
            moved[found[i].inst] = true
            brought += 1
        end
    end
    return brought
end

-- =========================================================
-- GUI
-- =========================================================
local THEME = {
    BG = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20),

        b.BackgroundColor3 = (n == name) and THEME.ACCENT or THEME.BTN

local function makeDraggable(object)
	local dragging = false
	local dragStart
	local startPosition

	object.InputBegan:Connect(function(inputObject)
		if inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			dragging = true
			dragStart = inputObject.Position
			startPosition = object.Position

			inputObject.Changed:Connect(function()
				if inputObject.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inputObject)
		if not dragging then
			return
		end

		if inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
			or inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			local delta = inputObject.Position - dragStart

			object.Position = UDim2.new(
				startPosition.X.Scale,
				startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
				startPosition.Y.Scale,
				startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
			)
		end
	end)
end

-- 1. DOT ESP (зелёная точка на дверях)
-- ============================================================
local dotESP = {}

local function getObjPos(obj)
	if obj:IsA("Model") then
		return obj:GetPivot().Position
	elseif obj:IsA("BasePart") then
		return obj.Position
	end
	return nil
end

local function addDot(obj, color, size)
	if dotESP[obj] then return end
	local pos = getObjPos(obj)
	if not pos then return end

	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "DotESP"
	gui.Size = UDim2.new(0, size, 0, size)
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.MaxDistance = 9999
	gui.Adornee = obj
	gui.Parent = obj

	local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
	dot.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	dot.BackgroundColor3 = color
	dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
	dot.Parent = gui

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	corner.Parent = dot

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	stroke.Thickness = 2
	stroke.Parent = dot

	dotESP[obj] = gui

	obj.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
		if parent == nil then
			if dotESP[obj] then
				dotESP[obj]:Destroy()
				dotESP[obj] = nil
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function removeDot(obj)
	if dotESP[obj] then
		dotESP[obj]:Destroy()
		dotESP[obj] = nil
	end
end

local function clearDoorDots()
	for obj, gui in pairs(dotESP) do
		if gui then gui:Destroy() end
		dotESP[obj] = nil
	end
end

local function scanDoorDots()
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj.Name == CONFIG.doorTargetName and (obj:IsA("Model") or obj:IsA("BasePart")) then
			addDot(obj, CONFIG.doorDotColor, CONFIG.doorDotSize)
		end
	end
end

local function startFly()
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return end
	flyBV = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	flyBV.Name = "FlyVelocity"
	flyBV.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
	flyBV.Velocity = Vector3.zero
	flyBV.Parent = hrp
	flyActive = true
end

local function stopFly()
	flyActive = false
	if flyBV then flyBV:Destroy() flyBV = nil end
end

local mobileUpHeld, mobileDownHeld = false, false

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not flyActive then return end
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not (hrp and hum) then return end
	if not flyBV or flyBV.Parent ~= hrp then startFly() end
	local move = hum.MoveDirection
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) or mobileUpHeld then
		move += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
	end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or mobileDownHeld then
		move -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
	end
	flyBV.Velocity = move * (VALUES.flySpeed * 30)
end)

local function applyNoclip()
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return end
	for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
			part.CanCollide = false
		end
	end
end

local function applyClip()
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return end
	for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.CanCollide = true
		end
	end
end

	if noclipActive then applyNoclip() end
end)

	if flyActive then task.wait(0.3) startFly() end

local function applyInstantPrompts()
	for _, p in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
			if p:GetAttribute("origHold") == nil then
				p:SetAttribute("origHold", p.HoldDuration)
				p:SetAttribute("origDist", p.MaxActivationDistance)
			end
			p.HoldDuration = 0
			p.MaxActivationDistance = math.max(p.MaxActivationDistance, 20)
		end
	end
end

local function restorePrompts()
	for _, p in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and p:GetAttribute("origHold") ~= nil then
			p.HoldDuration = p:GetAttribute("origHold")
			p.MaxActivationDistance = p:GetAttribute("origDist")
		end
	end
end

-- 8. ДЕТЕКТ СУЩНОСТЕЙ + УВЕДОМЛЕНИЯ

local seen = {}
local watchRoot = CONFIG.spawnFolder or workspace

local function isFake(obj)
	if CONFIG.blacklist[obj.Name] then return true end
	if obj.Name:lower():find("fake") then return true end
	return false
end

local function checkInstance(obj)
	if SETTINGS.doorESP and obj.Name == CONFIG.doorTargetName
		and (obj:IsA("Model") or obj:IsA("BasePart")) then
		addDot(obj, CONFIG.doorDotColor, CONFIG.doorDotSize)
	end

	if SETTINGS.instantPrompts and obj:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
		if obj:GetAttribute("origHold") == nil then
			obj:SetAttribute("origHold", obj.HoldDuration)
			obj:SetAttribute("origDist", obj.MaxActivationDistance)
		end
		obj.HoldDuration = 0
		obj.MaxActivationDistance = math.max(obj.MaxActivationDistance, 20)
	end

	local name = obj.Name
	if isFake(obj) then return end

	if CONFIG.entities[name] or (name:match("^A%-%d+") and obj:IsA("Model")) then
		if seen[obj] then return end
		seen[obj] = true

		if not CONFIG.entities[name] then
			CONFIG.entities[name] = {
				color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 30, 30),
				label = name .. " — Unknown Entity",
			}
		end

		if SETTINGS.notifications then
			showNotification(name)
		end

		obj.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
			if parent == nil then
				seen[obj] = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
	checkInstance(obj)
end

watchRoot.DescendantAdded:Connect(checkInstance)

	local tc = Instance.new("UICorner")

	local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	fill.Size = UDim2.new(startRel, 0, 1, 0)
	fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 130)

			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart
			menu.Position = UDim2.new(
				startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
				startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
			)
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = false
		end
	end)
end
